description: Shows the person's own business card for an event, the card a booth scan or a badge swap hands over: their first and last name, title and company, their LinkedIn link when their card carries one, the event's name, and their pass QR, which the Sonar Connections web scanner reads off the screen. The back lists the people they swapped cards with (first name and company, where and when), and for a person who staffs a booth, the booth's name, its staff first names and its raffle, drop and side-event titles. Clients that show cards draw it; the same card also comes as text. Needs a personal connector token. The event is `eventId` when given, otherwise the person's current event.

eventId.description: Optional. Event id, public slug or event name. When absent, the person's current event; with no current event, the card is drawn without an event and without a pass QR.

name: event_my_card
title: Show my business card
